analyses.name: order_value
analyses.question: How does fraud risk and fraud-labelled order value vary across order-value bands?
analyses.insight: SGD 100 to under 200 has the highest observed fraud rate among supported value bands: 57.2% (103/180 labelled orders). Compare its order volume and value exposure before allocating review effort.
analyses.limitation: Value bands are fixed operational groups. Country mix may affect global comparisons; the CSV retains country detail. Order value is not confirmed fraud loss.

analyses.name: weekday_collection
analyses.question: Which weekday and collection-method combinations have elevated fraud rates?
analyses.insight: Thursday, pickup, has the highest observed rate among supported groups: 30.6% (509/1,666 labelled orders). Use the pattern to plan investigation coverage alongside order volume.
analyses.limitation: Order dates support weekday analysis, not hour-of-day analysis. These associations do not establish causation or account for every country/customer difference.

analyses.name: customer_concentration
analyses.question: Which customers account for the most fraud-labelled orders, and how concentrated are those orders?
analyses.insight: The top 20 customers account for 759 fraud-labelled orders, or 0.7% of all fraud-labelled orders in scope. Prioritise investigation using repeated fraud counts together with each customer's labelled-order volume.
analyses.limitation: Ranked by fraud-labelled order count, then fraud-labelled order value. A high rate based on very few orders is uncertain. This is an investigation list, not an automated customer decision.
